'''Madison Smith Hedgecock''' (born August 27, 1981) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[Fullback (American football)|fullback]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) for seven seasons.  He played [[college football]] for the [[North Carolina Tar Heels football|University of North Carolina]]. '''Malcolm Barnwell''' (born June 28, 1958) is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[wide receiver]] for five seasons in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) for the [[Washington Redskins]], the [[New Orleans Saints]] and the [[Oakland Raiders|Oakland / Los Angeles Raiders]]. Barnwell was traded by the Raiders to the Redskins on August 26, 1985, in exchange for the Redskins' second-round pick in the [[1986 NFL draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/sports/1985/08/27/redskins-trade-brown-for-thielemann/8c548f2a-b530-4402-84ac-c2e6916317bb/|title=Redskins trade Brown for Thielemann|work=The Washington Post|date=August 27, 1985|accessdate=2020-04-05}}</ref> His best season was [[1984 NFL season|1984]], when he totaled 45 [[Reception (gridiron football)|reception]]s for 851 yards, an 18.9 avg. and two [[touchdown]]s, all career highs.

In 2019, Barnwell was interviewed for the Raiders official team website, where he talked about being scouted while playing for [[Virginia Union]], a historically black college and being scouted by Raiders legend Willie Brown.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.raiders.com/news/in-his-own-words-malcolm-barnwell-shares-his-nfl-journey-as-a-seventh-round-pick|title = In His Own Words: Malcolm Barnwell shares his NFL journey as a seventh-round pick}}</ref>
